articles.title: Constitutional Gating and Deterministic Recovery for Multi-Agent LLM Negotiation: Ablations Against a Stateful Adversarial Gatekeeper
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.11542v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems negotiating with a stateful counterpart waste model calls in three ways: polite loops that never meet the counterpart's hidden acceptance condition, malformed outputs that trigger retries, and compliance deadlocks in which the counterpart demands something the agent must refuse. We study a three-part control stack - a 5-Pillar runtime constitution, a 4-tier swarm (Director, three-agent majority vote, Monitor, schema hard gate) and Cognitive Annealing (deterministic deadlock detection, atomic purge of the agent-side context, a canonical recovery message) - against a released adversarial Gatekeeper whose acceptance rules are fixed regular expressions and whose LLM only renders reply text. The testbed has a known solution: it measures whether the stack executes a constitution-aligned strategy against swarm drift and recovers from deadlock, not whether it discovers anything. In five runs per configuration (30 runs; Gemini 2.5 Pro agents, Claude Haiku 4.5 Gatekeeper) we find: (i) the constitution and Director make an acceptable framing possible but not reliable - 0/5 baseline unlocks versus 1/5 and 2/5 with the constitution; when the swarm unlocks it does so in one turn with 7-8 calls and about 15k tokens (67-73% below baseline); when it does not, it costs 17-38% more; (ii) the Monitor and hard gate do not reduce unlocks and leave an audit trail; (iii) under a honeytrap-to-compliance deadlock, LLM-only steering escapes 0 of 5 times while atomic purge plus a canonical strike escapes 5 of 5 (Fisher $p = 0.008$) at the same call budget, with zero calls for the strike. LLM-written strikes failed the deterministic pre-flight 5 of 5 times although an LLM Monitor had approved four. Pre-registered hypotheses on average call and token reduction were not supported. Cost is bounded in every arm by deterministic stop rules; the stack adds recovery at no extra model cost.

articles.title: Large Language Model-Assisted Preparation of Transportation Management Plans: A Case Study with WisDOT WisTMP System
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.10650v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Work zones are critical yet hazardous components of transportation infrastructure, requiring carefully designed Transportation Management Plans (TMPs) to ensure safety and mobility. However, TMP preparation remains labor-intensive and heavily dependent on practitioner expertise. This paper proposes a Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted framework to automate TMP content generation, leveraging the WisDOT WisTMP system as the application context. The framework fine-tunes multiple open-source LLMs across different model scales and deploys them locally to ensure data security. To support model training, we construct a domain-specific dataset from historical WisTMP documents by converting PDF files into structured question-answer pairs in JSON format. Experimental results show that fine-tuning significantly improves performance across standard text generation metrics. Further section-wise and strategy-level analyses reveal that, while LLMs achieve strong overall performance, they tend to over-generate strategies and struggle to produce project-specific justifications and accurate cost estimates. In addition, scaling from 7B/8B to 14B yields limited gains. These findings demonstrate the potential of LLMs to improve TMP preparation efficiency while highlighting remaining challenges in LLM-assisted TMP development. The source code and demo videos will be publicly available at https://zihaosheng.github.io/TMP-LLM/.

articles.title: 谷歌预告 10 月 12 日将推新品，预估为 Fitbit Edge 手环
articles.text:
IT之家 10 月 10 日消息，谷歌 Google Health 官方账号（@googlehealth）今天（10 月 10 日）在 X 平台发布推文，预告将于 10 月 12 日发布新款产品，预估关联近期 Fitbit Edge 健身手环。
图片展示了疑似设备侧边按键，配文写有“Get an Edge on your health”和“10.12.26”。
这款设备的相关图片最早可追溯至 8 月。当时，9to5Google 在谷歌 Pixel 11 的宣传材料中发现一款未命名健身追踪器。法国媒体 Dealabs 后续报道了设计、续航和可能售价等信息。
据 Dealabs 报道，关闭常亮显示后，Fitbit Edge 单次充电续航最长可达 7 天；开启后约为 2 天。报道还称，该设备在欧洲的售价可能为 179 欧元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,347 元人民币）。
延伸阅读
谷歌与 Fitbit 的关联可追溯至 2019 年。2019 年 11 月 1 日，Fitbit 宣布与谷歌达成最终协议，谷歌以每股 7.35 美元（现汇率约合 49.4 元人民币）现金收购 Fitbit，对应完全稀释股权价值约 21 亿美元（现汇率约合 141.02 亿元人民币）；该交易在通过监管审批后于 2021 年 1 月完成。此后 Fitbit 品牌与产品线逐步整合进谷歌的健康硬件体系。
在 Fitbit Edge 之前，谷歌于 2026 年 5 月推出无屏幕、无按键的健身手环 Fitbit Air，主打极简无感，重量约 5.2 克，续航可达 7 天，售价 99.99 美元（现汇率约合 671.5 元人民币）起，核心监测功能无需订阅即可使用。Fitbit Edge 的定位介于 Fitbit Air 与 Pixel Watch 5 之间。
根据 Dealabs 与 Android Headline 等渠道的爆料，Fitbit Edge 配备 1.34 英寸 AMOLED 屏幕，提供 4 种配色组合（分别对应哑光黑、缎面黄铁矿色、香槟金、抛光银等铝制机身与不同运动表带），内置 Gemini 个性化教练，运动模式超过 40 种，支持蓝牙 5.4 与 GPS，兼容运行安卓 11 及更高版本的手机以及 iOS 16.4 及更高版本的 iPhone。
文中提及的部分功能可能需要 Google Health Premium 订阅。该服务前身为 Fitbit Premium，月费 9.99 美元（现汇率约合 67.1 元人民币）、年费 99.99 美元（现汇率约合 671.5 元人民币），提供由 Gemini 驱动的健康指导、自适应健身计划和更深入的睡眠洞察等；谷歌称其已包含在 Google AI Pro 及 AI Ultra 订阅内。
需要说明的是，常亮显示（AOD）指屏幕在待机状态下仍以低亮度持续显示时间等信息，是这类设备耗电增加的主要原因之一；AMOLED 是一种自发光显示技术；ECG 指心电图检测，SpO2 指血氧饱和度监测。Fitbit Edge 所运行的 Fitbit OS 是 Fitbit 设备使用的操作系统。

articles.title: 长安启源 Q06 新增宁德时代电池选装，纯电里程 602 公里
articles.text:
IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，据易车报道，10 月 9 日，长安启源 Q06 正式面向 602 智享型、602 越享型车型，推出宁德时代电芯选装包。用户可选择将 66.02 度中创新航 800V 6C 电芯，升级为同容量规格的 66.02 度宁德时代 800V 6C 电芯，选装升级后整车续航里程维持不变。
据介绍，无论是原车标配的中创新航电芯，还是可选装的宁德时代电芯，均纳入长安自研金钟罩电池包完整体系，执行统一的央企严苛品控与安全验证标准，整车性能表现、续航输出以及质保权益完全一致。两套方案同样搭载 800V 碳化硅高压平台、支持 6C 闪充，共享金钟罩电池全套安全防护、长寿命设计，以及首任非营运用户电池终身质保政策。
据IT之家此前报道，长安启源 Q06 于 9 月 23 日上市，提供纯电与增程两种动力选择，官方指导价 13.99-16.99 万元。
车身尺寸方面，启源 Q06 长宽高分别为 4837mm、1970mm、1670mm，轴距达到 2940mm。启源 Q06 车顶搭载激光雷达，将首搭长安天枢领航 Ultra，具备端到端城市领航能力。
新车搭载长安天枢座舱 2.0，配备双 TC399 芯片，搭载天枢智能体“小安”。其车内配备大尺寸悬浮式中控屏、全液晶仪表、大尺寸 HUD 以及三辐式多功能方向盘。此外，新车还搭载 15.6 英寸后排娱乐屏、后排小桌板、后排电动遮阳帘、后排隐私玻璃、副驾驶零重力座椅及车载冰箱，全车座椅均配备通风、加热及按摩功能。

articles.title: 苹果 Home 应用新特性：iPhone 靠近门铃，灵动岛预览视频画面
articles.text:
IT之家 10 月 10 日消息，消息源 @itspdfu 昨日（10 月 9 日）发布博文，报道称苹果和 LG 合作开发的智能家居配件支持“接近控制”功能。用户将 iPhone 靠近兼容配件后，可通过灵动岛提示打开控制界面，而摄像头和门铃还可直接显示画面。
没有灵动岛功能的 iPhone 或 iPad 将显示 30 秒通知，用户可以在设置完成后，在“家庭”应用中禁用此功能。在后台，该配件会将“apple-deviceid”写入存储在其 NFC 标签上的 Matter 有效载荷中，以便 iOS 在轻触时识别它。它还会广播用于 Apple 近距离控制的低功耗蓝牙广告。
消息称苹果在 iOS 27 系统中就引入了相关代码，IT之家援引博文介绍，在 iOS 27.2 Beta 3 更新中，苹果已上线切换选项，包括以下 3 个选项：
从不：禁用接近控制。
请求启动：显示动态岛屿提示或通知，其中包含指向控制卡的深度链接。
自动启动：显示控制卡。
延伸阅读
此次曝光的“接近控制”功能与苹果和 LG 的智能家居配件合作密切相关。据彭博社报道，苹果与 LG 合作开发一系列智能家居产品，传闻中的设备包括视频门铃、智能温控器、门锁、室内外摄像头和泛光灯摄像头，部分产品预计支持 Matter 和 Thread 协议。这批产品将贴 LG 的品牌，制造和售后由 LG 负责，苹果主要参与联合研发以使产品适配自家生态。
苹果已宣布将于 2026 年 10 月 13 日举办以智能家居为主题的“Welcome Home”活动，预计推出新一代 Apple TV 4K、HomePod mini 以及一款全新的家庭中枢设备。据爆料，该家庭中枢搭载约 6 英寸方形触控屏，运行内部代号为“Charismatic”的新系统，该系统可能命名为 homeOS；LG 配件是否会在活动上亮相，目前尚无官方确认。
除“接近控制”外，iOS 27 代码与 LG 设备固件还显示了一项 HomeKit 专属的“未通电先配对”功能：用户将 iPhone 靠近门锁、恒温器等设备时，可通过 NFC 预先把配对身份和 Wi-Fi / Thread 网络凭证写入设备的安全元件，设备通电后自动入网，再由家庭中枢完成 Matter 配置。LG 门锁与恒温器固件中据称出现了 NXP SE051H 安全元件，且固件将 Matter NFC 小程序替换为 HomeKit 专用小程序。
关于文中提到的 Matter 与 NFC：Matter 是多家厂商共同推动的智能家居互操作标准，传统配网需扫描二维码或手动输入配对码，并通过低功耗蓝牙把信息传送到智能家居中枢。Matter 1.4 增加了使用 NFC 启动配网流程的能力，但仍依赖蓝牙；Matter 1.6 则实现了完全通过 NFC 完成整个配网过程，目标设备甚至无需通电，必要信息可先保存在 NFC 芯片中，待设备通电后再传输。文中提及的 NFC 标签与 Matter 有效载荷即属于这一机制范畴。
灵动岛（Dynamic Island）是苹果自 iPhone 14 Pro 系列起引入的屏幕交互区域，后续 iPhone 15、16、17 系列及 iPhone 18 系列机型均已配备。因此文中提到的“没有灵动岛功能的 iPhone”主要指更早的机型，这些设备以及 iPad 在接近控制场景下会改用约 30 秒的通知提示。

articles.title: LadderEdit: Edit-Level Residual Compression for Memory-Efficient Lifelong Editing of LLMs
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.11160v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Lifelong editing of LLMs requires storing thousands of edits after acquisition. A widely used family of approaches attaches one LoRA adapter per edit, which preserves behavior but grows linearly in storage. To address this challenge, we propose LadderEdit, a method that compresses each LoRA adapter after it is acquired. Each edit is first stored at low rank as a cheap sketch. We then check whether this sketch still satisfies the rewrite, generalization, and locality contract on probe prompts. Edits that pass keep the sketch; those that fail are promoted to a higher rank along a ladder until the contract is met. Because every edit retains some representation, coverage is maintained, and only hard edits consume more rank. Across ZsRE, CounterFact, and WikiBigEdit benchmarks on LLaMA-3-8B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen2.5-7B, LadderEdit tracks exact LoRA storage at 5.2x less memory and remains effective at 50,000 sequential edits.

articles.title: Measuring Cultural Alignment Beyond the Average: A Framework for Evaluating Maternal-Health LLM Interactions in Indian Contexts
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.11586v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Existing evaluation methods for healthcare LLMs primarily assess factual correctness,safety, and fluency, while providing limited insight into whether generated interactions reflect culturally situated healthcare reasoning. This limitation is particularly important in maternal health, where care decisions are shaped by social and relational norms. We introduce MH-INDIC, a culturally grounded evaluation framework for maternal-health interactions in urban and semi-urban North Indian contexts that operationalises cultural behaviour through ten dimensions of maternal-health reasoning. Using a 26-item survey administered to 102 pregnant and postpartum women from urban and semi-urban North India, we evaluate ten LLMs. We distinguish population level cultural alignment from profile-level behavioural variation. Although several models approximate the human population-level distribution, all evaluated systems exhibit substantially lower variation across demographic and household profiles than the human cohort, revealing a gap between aggregate alignment and profile-conditioned sensitivity. As a downstream application of MH-INDIC, we use the strongest-aligned proprietary and open-source models to generate culturally conditioned maternal-health dialogues under zero-shot, self-conditioned, and human-grounded prompting. Human-grounded conditioning produces stronger profile alignment and dialogue quality ratings, suggesting that measured cultural profiles can improve the cultural grounding of generated interactions
